meta.name: hellenist_city_invasion
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern Hellenist coastal metropolis under leviathan assault

programs.brief: A colossal ancient sea leviathan emerging from the deep bay waters with multiple luminous eyes, spiked chitinous ridges, and a coiled serpentine body breaking the surface to strike at the city waterfront.
A monumental Hellenist bronze and quartz colossus statue standing atop a coastal promontory, arm outstretched holding a radiant beacon spear pointed directly at the invading sea beasts.
A massive barbed kraken tentacle rearing up from the water or smashing down on the promenade, glistening with suction discs and sea foam.

tokens.terrain: a modern coastal city with a wide waterfront promenade and open sea
tokens.event_direction: giant sea monsters emerge from the open water attacking the coastal promenade and harbour front
tokens.infra: barricade_line along the waterfront boulevard; emergency_cordon sealing off the damaged quays
tokens.icons: monumental colonnaded modern buildings; wide marble-lined avenues meeting the sea; breaching tentacles and leviathans crushing piers
